code: const out={}; const T=async(k,f)=>{const t=Date.now(); await Word.run(f); out[k]=Date.now()-t;}; await T("style1",async(c)=>{const p=c.document.body.paragraphs.getLast(); p.style="Action"; await c.sync();}); await T("style2same",async(c)=>{const p=c.document.body.paragraphs.getLast(); p.style="Action"; await c.sync();}); await T("styleChar",async(c)=>{const p=c.document.body.paragraphs.getLast(); p.style="Character"; await c.sync();}); await T("styleBuiltin",async(c)=>{const p=c.document.body.paragraphs.getLast(); p.styleBuiltIn=Word.Style.normal; await c.sync();}); await T("styleBack",async(c)=>{const p=c.document.body.paragraphs.getLast(); p.style="Action"; await c.sync();}); await T("spaceAfter",async(c)=>{const p=c.document.body.paragraphs.getLast(); p.spaceAfter=0; await c.sync();}); await T("insertEmpty",async(c)=>{const p=c.document.body.paragraphs.getLast(); p.getRange("Content").insertText("","Replace"); await c.sync();}); return out;
